nodes.label: DO NOW: payments + card-required paywall (greenfield, 3-4 eng-weeks)
nodes.rationale: No Stripe/Razorpay code exists; dual-rail is mandatory (Stripe won't collect domestic INR — Razorpay for India). Done when a live charge clears in both INR and USD and the funnel convert step reads real data.

nodes.label: DO NOW: compliance-by-design sprint (1 eng-week, mostly copy)
nodes.rationale: Cheapest unblock in the company: disclaim every performance number, reframe consensus copy, persistent paper-only banner, India lagged data, and $1-3k one-time India securities-lawyer review of disclaimers.

nodes.label: Live undisclaimed 77% 'ultra-tier accuracy' stat
nodes.rationale: The marketed accuracy number is 77%, not a 'buried' 56% — a published predictive performance claim with no disclaimer, the single largest SEBI/legal exposure on the site today; kill or disclaim it first.

nodes.label: Fully synthetic admin conversion funnel
nodes.rationale: proFunnel returns mulberry32-seeded counts with hardcoded decay ratios; 'wiring the charge into the convert step' means replacing mock data with real events end-to-end, not incrementing a live counter.

nodes.label: DO NEXT: license real IV/Greeks feed
nodes.rationale: Synthetic IV is invisible to beginners but fatal the moment a prosumer pays against Unusual Whales; license after the paywall proves people pay, budget $1-4K/mo not $500-2K.

nodes.label: DO NEVER list (forecast-accuracy chasing, premature mobile, broker links, community-before-users)
nodes.rationale: Months of ML for ~4 accuracy points moves revenue $0 and deepens predictive-claim liability; freeze the forecaster and point ML time at the /api/explain teacher — the SKU that gates and converts.

hyperedges.label: Path to first dollar: monetization ladder -> paywall build + compliance sprint/punch-list, funded by the bootstrap spine under CAC-by-cohort discipline
